data.narrative:
Eikon Therapeutics is a publicly traded biotech company founded by Luke Lavis, Eric Betzig, Robert Tjian, and Xavier Darzacq. The company has raised over $1.1B in private capital plus $381M at IPO, establishing a current market valuation of $539M. Valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 3 public-stage peers in the Biotech & Health sector, supplemented by 8 private-stage reference companies including Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Freenome, and Alto Neuroscience.

The peer-median method is applicable and forms the primary triangulation anchor. Across three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), and Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B)—the median valuation is $1.1B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $1.6B. Public-comp anchoring using a sector P/S median of 8.1x across three biotech tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) cannot be applied, as target revenue is not disclosed.

The single applicable method supports a triangulated range of $935M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $1.1B. The current $539M valuation sits materially below the peer median, suggesting either market-specific discount or incomplete pricing of pipeline value. Key uncertainties include pipeline advancement, clinical risk, and execution relative to stated comparables. Revenue disclosure would enable P/S cross-validation.
